subject: Create React App
shortDescription: Create React App is deprecated; migrate to modern tooling.
impactExplanation: Older tutorials treat CRA as the default React setup, but new projects are expected to use alternatives (for example Vite or framework CLIs), so CRA-first guidance is weakened.
description: Create React App is deprecated; migrate to modern tooling.

subject: React StrictMode
shortDescription: StrictMode may double-invoke renders/effects in development.
impactExplanation: Older guidance may interpret double renders/effects as a bug; modern React intentionally does this in development to surface unsafe side effects.
description: StrictMode may double-invoke renders/effects in development.

subject: React 18 rendering API
shortDescription: ReactDOM.render is replaced by the createRoot API in React 18.
impactExplanation: Tutorials that instruct using ReactDOM.render will not match the current recommended setup and may fail or require changes in React 18+ projects.
description: ReactDOM.render is replaced by the createRoot API in React 18.

subject: React 18 state updates
shortDescription: More updates are automatically batched, changing update timing.
impactExplanation: Advice that relies on immediate state update timing can behave differently under React 18 automatic batching, especially around async boundaries.
description: More updates are automatically batched, changing update timing.

subject: React Router
shortDescription: Switch is replaced by Routes and route matching semantics change.
impactExplanation: React Router v5 tutorials that use Switch and v5 matching semantics do not translate directly to v6 projects without changes.
description: Switch is replaced by Routes and route matching semantics change.

subject: React Router navigation API
shortDescription: useHistory is replaced by useNavigate; navigation APIs differ.
impactExplanation: Tutorials written for React Router v5 often reference useHistory and related APIs, which are replaced in v6.
description: useHistory is replaced by useNavigate; navigation APIs differ.

subject: React Hooks lint rules
shortDescription: Hook linting enforces effect dependencies; missing deps are flagged.
impactExplanation: Older tutorials often omit dependencies in useEffect; modern tooling flags this as a correctness issue and encourages different patterns.
description: Hook linting enforces effect dependencies; missing deps are flagged.

subject: Firebase Web SDK
shortDescription: Firebase JS SDK moved to modular v9 imports from namespaced APIs.
impactExplanation: Older guides use namespaced imports (firebase.firestore(), etc.); modern SDK usage requires modular imports and different initialization patterns.
description: Firebase JS SDK moved to modular v9 imports from namespaced APIs.

subject: TypeScript + Node ESM
shortDescription: NodeNext module resolution affects ESM imports and package exports.
impactExplanation: Older CommonJS-focused examples can break under ESM/exports rules, changing how imports, file extensions, and package entry points must be written.
description: NodeNext module resolution affects ESM imports and package exports.

subject: AngularJS
shortDescription: AngularJS reached end of life and no longer receives official support.
impactExplanation: Tutorials that recommend AngularJS or assume ongoing security fixes are unsafe to follow for new work because the framework is no longer supported.
description: AngularJS reached end of life and no longer receives official support.

subject: Vue 2
shortDescription: Vue 2 reached end of life and is no longer maintained.
impactExplanation: Guides written for Vue 2 can be risky because Vue 3 is the maintained major version and Vue 2 no longer receives fixes.
description: Vue 2 reached end of life and is no longer maintained.

subject: Python 2
shortDescription: Python 2 reached end of life and no longer receives security fixes.
impactExplanation: Older tutorials that assume Python 2 availability or recommend Python 2 are unsafe for modern environments and often cannot be reproduced today.
description: Python 2 reached end of life and no longer receives security fixes.

subject: Node.js 12
shortDescription: Node.js 12 reached end of life and is no longer supported.
impactExplanation: Tutorials pinned to Node 12 are risky: modern platforms and dependencies frequently require newer Node versions and security updates are no longer provided.
description: Node.js 12 reached end of life and is no longer supported.

subject: Node.js 14
shortDescription: Node.js 14 reached end of life and is no longer supported.
impactExplanation: Guides that require Node 14 can fail on modern tooling and hosting providers that have moved to newer supported Node versions.
description: Node.js 14 reached end of life and is no longer supported.

subject: npm distribution
shortDescription: npm is distributed with Node.js in official Node installers.
impactExplanation: Older instructions to install npm separately are unnecessary today and can lead to version mismatches or broken environments.
description: npm is distributed with Node.js in official Node installers.

subject: npm 7 peer dependencies
shortDescription: npm 7 changed peer dependency resolution and may auto-install peers.
impactExplanation: Older install steps that assumed npm would ignore peer dependency conflicts can behave differently, producing new install failures or unexpected dependency trees.
description: npm 7 changed peer dependency resolution and may auto-install peers.

subject: npx
shortDescription: npx became available via npm 5.2.0 to run package binaries without global installs.
impactExplanation: Older tutorials that require global installs for common CLIs are weakened because modern workflows often use npx to run tools on-demand.
description: npx became available via npm 5.2.0 to run package binaries without global installs.

subject: Yarn Berry (Yarn 2+)
shortDescription: Yarn 2+ (Berry) introduced major workflow changes (including Plug'n'Play by default).
impactExplanation: Tutorials written for Yarn v1 that assume node_modules behavior can break or require extra configuration in Yarn Berry projects.
description: Yarn 2+ (Berry) introduced major workflow changes (including Plug'n'Play by default).

subject: Docker Compose
shortDescription: Docker Compose v1 is deprecated in favor of Docker Compose v2 (docker compose).
impactExplanation: Older guides that rely on Compose v1 installation steps or behavior can fail on modern Docker setups where Compose v2 is the supported path.
description: Docker Compose v1 is deprecated in favor of Docker Compose v2 (docker compose).

subject: Heroku
shortDescription: Heroku removed its free product plans.
impactExplanation: Tutorials that depend on a free Heroku deployment path are no longer reproducible without paid plans, weakening or invalidating the recommended workflow.
description: Heroku removed its free product plans.

subject: Firebase Cloud Functions
shortDescription: Deploying Cloud Functions typically requires enabling billing (Blaze plan).
impactExplanation: Older tutorials that claim Cloud Functions can be used indefinitely on a free plan can mislead users; deployments often require a billing account to proceed.
description: Deploying Cloud Functions typically requires enabling billing (Blaze plan).

subject: GitHub default branch
shortDescription: GitHub changed the default branch name for new repositories from master to main.
impactExplanation: Older tutorials that assume the default branch is master can break copy-paste commands and CI configurations in new repositories.
description: GitHub changed the default branch name for new repositories from master to main.

subject: Travis CI
shortDescription: Travis CI ended unlimited free builds for many open source projects and moved to paid plans.
impactExplanation: Tutorials that recommend Travis CI as a free default CI option are weakened because the pricing and access model changed.
description: Travis CI ended unlimited free builds for many open source projects and moved to paid plans.

subject: CircleCI
shortDescription: CircleCI moved to credit-based usage and plan limits that affect build workflows.
impactExplanation: Older tutorials that assume CircleCI is effectively free for common workloads can mislead users; usage is bounded by plan credits and limits.
description: CircleCI moved to credit-based usage and plan limits that affect build workflows.

subject: Kubernetes Ingress API
shortDescription: Kubernetes removed several v1beta1 APIs in v1.22 (including Ingress v1beta1).
impactExplanation: Older Kubernetes manifests that use deprecated v1beta1 API versions can fail to apply on modern clusters.
description: Kubernetes removed several v1beta1 APIs in v1.22 (including Ingress v1beta1).

subject: Kubernetes PodSecurityPolicy
shortDescription: Kubernetes removed PodSecurityPolicy in v1.25.
impactExplanation: Guides that rely on PodSecurityPolicy for cluster security controls no longer work on modern Kubernetes versions and must be updated to newer mechanisms.
description: Kubernetes removed PodSecurityPolicy in v1.25.

subject: OAuth 2.0 implicit grant
shortDescription: OAuth 2.0 implicit flow is discouraged in favor of Authorization Code with PKCE for SPAs.
impactExplanation: Older SPA authentication tutorials that use the implicit flow can be insecure or rejected by modern providers; current guidance expects PKCE.
description: OAuth 2.0 implicit flow is discouraged in favor of Authorization Code with PKCE for SPAs.

subject: TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1
shortDescription: TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 were deprecated and widely disabled by major clients and services.
impactExplanation: Older deployment guides that assume TLS 1.0/1.1 compatibility can fail modern security requirements and break connectivity with updated clients.
description: TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 were deprecated and widely disabled by major clients and services.

subject: SHA-1
shortDescription: SHA-1 is deprecated for security uses and is rejected by many modern systems.
impactExplanation: Older security and certificate guidance that relies on SHA-1 can fail modern validation and is considered insecure.
description: SHA-1 is deprecated for security uses and is rejected by many modern systems.

subject: GitHub HTTPS Git authentication
shortDescription: GitHub removed password authentication for Git operations over HTTPS.
impactExplanation: Older tutorials that instruct using a GitHub username/password for git push over HTTPS no longer work; modern workflows use tokens or SSH keys.
description: GitHub removed password authentication for Git operations over HTTPS.

subject: Password-only authentication
shortDescription: Modern security guidance discourages password-only authentication for high-value accounts.
impactExplanation: Older advice that treats passwords as sufficient can be unsafe today; modern defaults often require MFA and stronger account protection policies.
description: Modern security guidance discourages password-only authentication for high-value accounts.

subject: Spring Boot 3 / Jakarta EE
shortDescription: Spring Boot 3 migrated from javax.* to jakarta.* namespaces and requires newer platform baselines.
impactExplanation: Tutorials targeting older Spring Boot versions can break because common imports and dependencies moved to jakarta.* and baseline requirements changed.
description: Spring Boot 3 migrated from javax.* to jakarta.* namespaces and requires newer platform baselines.

subject: Django 2.0
shortDescription: Django 2.0 dropped support for Python 2.
impactExplanation: Older Django tutorials that assume Python 2 compatibility cannot be reproduced with modern Django versions and often require Python 3.
description: Django 2.0 dropped support for Python 2.

subject: Rails Webpacker
shortDescription: Rails Webpacker was deprecated in favor of newer Rails JavaScript approaches.
impactExplanation: Rails tutorials that assume Webpacker as the default asset pipeline are weakened because Rails moved toward alternatives (importmaps, jsbundling, etc.).
description: Rails Webpacker was deprecated in favor of newer Rails JavaScript approaches.
